messages:
release-manager: Heads up — we need to pause the EU change window. Incident CI-387 is causing downstream DB tail latencies. Holding any deploys that touch the routing service until we have a mitigation.

deploy-bot: @channel Automated hold applied to rollout group `eu-zone-rollouts` by policy:incident-hold. All pending deploys queued.

sre-oncall: Confirmed. We saw 5xx spikes starting at 07:12 UTC tied to a pooled connection exhaustion in routing-db. Mitigating now — adding connection limits and draining one replica. ETA 20–30m.

jane: Thanks. For the release scheduled at 08:00 (v3.5.0-canary), do we want to unpin canaries or push rollback?

miguel: Recommend we cancel canary and pin prod to v3.4.2 for now. v3.5.0 includes the new batching kernel which touches KV cache routing — risky during DB instability.

alex: Agree with pin. Action items: 1) stop canary 2) set prod pin to `v3.4.2` 3) update release notes with hold + reason.

release-manager: I'll update notes. Wording proposal: "Release delayed due to incident affecting routing DB; changes involving KV cache/routing deferred. Teams will be notified once the window reopens." Anyone object?

sre-oncall: No objection. After mitigation I'll validate tail latencies for 15m and post back. If stable, we can reschedule a limited canary at reduced concurrency.

deploy-bot: Executing commands:```/deploy cancel canary v3.5.0-canary --group eu-zone-rollouts``` -> success. Queue length: 3 deploys deferred.

ops-bot: Noted. Creating post-incident release plan doc and a pinned comment in the release channel. Link: https://redwood.internal/notes/CI-387-release-hold (internal)

miguel: When we unhold, let's do staggered canary: 1% -> 5% -> 25% with health checks: error rate < 0.1% and p95 latency within 5% baseline. Also require KV cache compatibility smoke tests.

jane: I'll schedule a shortened change window at 13:00 UTC if SRE gives green. Otherwise we push to next day's maintenance window.

sre-oncall: Mitigation rolled at 07:38 UTC: connection_limiter applied, one replica drained and restarted. Running validation now.

sre-oncall: Validation: 30m running, p95 latency back to baseline, 5xx below threshold. Recommend conditional unhold: canary with reduced concurrency and telemetry guardrails.

release-manager: Ok — unhold plan: release-manager will remove incident-hold, deploy-bot will schedule a staggered canary for `v3.5.0-canary` with the policy `staggered-low` and a 45m observation period. If any guardrail trips, automatic rollback to `v3.4.2` will be triggered.

deploy-bot: Policy applied. Scheduling canary: ETA 13:05 UTC. Notifying owners.

jane: Thanks everyone. I'll update the release notes to reflect the delay and the new observation plan.

alex: Quick note — we should add a follow-up task in the sprint to run a postmortem on KV cache routing assumptions.

release-manager: Added. Closing thread once canary completes or is rolled back.

ops-bot: Incident CI-387 status updated: hold -> conditional-unhold (canary scheduled). Ticket updated and linked to release notes.
